The '''mother''' of [[Vector Hyllus]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="Codex" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' labels Jurio as Vector Hyllus's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' specifies the existence of a [[Jurio system/Legends|Jurio system]]. [[Jason Fry]], author of the Atlas, has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] "planets not assigned a system in [a] published source can be assumed to reside in [the] system of [the] same name." Therefore, Jurio is assumed to be a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and not a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] or other body.</ref> [[Jurio]]. After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] conquered their world, they met an Imperial [[Captain/Legends|captain]] named [[Adronik Hyllus]], and the two were [[Marriage/Legends|married]] after Jurio was granted Imperial governance.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3666 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the mother gave [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to a son they and Hyllus named [[Vector Hyllus|Vector]], who grew up during the Imperial reconstruction of Jurio and joined the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]] at an early age.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vector Hyllus's mother was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Vector Hyllus, a companion character for the [[Imperial Agent]] class in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
